how_to_use: Edit this file only; run: python run_all.py
Define one or more jobs under `jobs`.
Each job inherits `defaults`; job-level module blocks override defaults.
__doc__.paper_and_code_mapping_doc: See config/PARAMETER_REFERENCE.md for full parameter-by-parameter mapping to paper sections and baseline values.

__doc__.enabled: Run multiple jobs in parallel processes. Paper does not define this; engineering runtime control.
__doc__.max_workers: Maximum concurrent jobs when parallel.enabled=true. Paper does not define this.

__doc__.data_path: Input panel-IV dataset path. Maps to paper Tables 1-6 empirical sample.
__doc__.standardize_residualized: Scaling mode for first/second moments. Paper table notes state residualized unit-standard-deviation scaling over the regression sample (PDF p.10, p.13, p.15-17). Baseline replication keeps 'none' for raw coefficient scale.

__doc__.data_path: Input IV-VAR sample. Maps to paper Figure 6-7 sample (GDP growth, returns, volatility).
__doc__.n_starts: Number of deterministic multi-start solves for GMM. Not explicitly in paper; implementation stabilization.
__doc__.start_jitter: Std. dev. of random perturbation around initial guess for extra starts. Not in paper.
__doc__.selection_mode: objective: minimum objective; paper_anchor: among near-optimal solutions pick one closest to paper Figure 6 impact language.
__doc__.objective_tie_tol: Near-optimal objective tolerance used by paper_anchor selection. Not in paper.
__doc__.target_impact_t1: Paper anchor for Figure 6 immediate impact. Paper text: 'just over 3.5 percentage points' drop (PDF p.22).
__doc__.diag_floor: Regularity floor for B22/B33 in paper_anchor candidate filtering. Not in paper.
__doc__.bootstrap_n: Bootstrap replications for Figure 6 confidence bands. Original MATLAB baseline uses 150.
__doc__.bootstrap_block_size: Stationary block bootstrap mean block length. Original MATLAB baseline uses 25.

__doc__.data_path: Input disaster-event VAR dataset for LMN-style admissible-set analysis (paper Figures 3-5).
__doc__.n_draws: Admissible-set random draws. Paper discusses admissible responses (Figure 3); published text does not state N explicitly. Original baseline MATLAB code sets N=1,500,000.

__doc__.simplified: Use reduced grids for faster checks. Supplemental MODEL is outside the published main-paper quantitative targets.
__doc__.do_estimation: Run full GMM estimation in model block (very expensive). Supplemental module option.
__doc__.irf_t: IRF horizon in quarters for Figure 8-style output.
__doc__.irf_n_sims: Number of simulation paths averaged for IRF.

__doc__.name: Unique run name; outputs in output/runs/<name>/
__doc__.enabled: Whether this job is active in default run.
__doc__.module_override: Optional module blocks (iv/iv_var/lmn_var/model) to override defaults for this job.
